source_title: Kylie Kelce Defends Her Family’s Decision to Buy Up the Properties Around Her and Husband Jason’s Home - People.com
source_excerpt:
The mom of four explained her family’s reasoning behind the real estate purchases in an Oct. 29 episode of her ‘Not Gonna Lie’ podcast
Not Gonna Lie with Kylie Kelce; Kylie Kelce/Instagram
Kylie Kelce called out an Instagram account for sharing an aerial view and details about her family’s property in a new episode of her Not Gonna Lie podcast
The mom of four said owning the neighboring homes helps provide safety, privacy and security for her family
She admitted to commenting on the Instagram post to explain her reasoning
Kylie Kelce is setting the record straight about her family’s decision to own multiple homes right next to each other.
During the Thursday, Oct. 29, episode of her Not Gonna Lie podcast with guest Nikki Glaser , Kelce, 34, discussed the topic of hate comments and whether she ever responds to them.
“Do you ever get in the comments? Do you ever get feisty?” Glaser asks Kelce. In response, the mom of four brings up an Instagram account that posted details about the home she lives in with her husband, retired NFL star Jason Kelce , and their children: daughters Finnley, 18 months, Bennett, 3, Elliotte, 5, and Wyatt, 7 .
“One of the ones that I did it — which was not to a person so it doesn’t really feel as aggressive — was like ‘Celeb Homes.’” Kylie recalls, referring to the account. “They put a bird’s eye view of where we live with our children, and they were trying to give details of our property.”
After explaining that she and her family bought another house “next door to us,” Kylie says the account questioned why they would need so many homes.
“[They were like], ‘why would you need this many houses?’ And I’m like, ‘for f---ing security and privacy, you pieces of s---,” she continues. “They left the post up, so it’s still there. You can still find it.”
The exact comment Kylie left on the post reads: “‘Why would anyone need three neighboring properties?’ For safety, privacy, and security. Get the f outta here.”
She concludes the tale by telling Glaser, “I think I typed ‘get f---ed.’ And then when I tried to post it, it wouldn’t let me. Why? I want to tell people to get f---ed.
Kylie also got into a number of other topics during the episode, including what her kids are going to dress up as for Halloween this year.
“We have Nova from Zombies 4. We have Red from Descendants . We have Queen of Hearts because Benny wanted to wear red lipstick or Leila from Teen Beach Movie ,” she shared. “I don’t know which one ... yet. I think that’s going to be a game-time decision. And Finny is a cupcake.”
The podcaster went on to reveal more details about her baby girl’s cupcake costume, noting that it comes with an adorable headband that she’s not confident will actually be worn by her daughter.
“There’s a headband. Zero chance she wears it. It’s what ties the whole costume together,” she said. “It’s so cute. It’s a little cherry on top. It is adorable.”
Kylie noted that if she’s able to get just one photo of her daughter in the full costume, she’ll be happy.
“If I can successfully get a picture of her wearing the cupcake topper without it being disrupted or removed, I’m calling Halloween as a whole a win,” she said.
